//: The KPI Tree connector's tools and period comparisons, published by the KPI Tree team from the connector itself. Do not edit by hand: evals/ci/validate.py checks every tool the skills name against this file, and a connector change arrives as a new version of it.

tools.name: accept_briefing_action
tools.title: Accept Briefing Action
tools.summary: Take one of the actions a briefing recommended, on the person's say-so.

tools.name: add_context
tools.title: Add Context
tools.summary: Record a plain-English fact about the business so agents factor it in later.

tools.name: add_metric_to_tree
tools.title: Add Metric to Tree
tools.summary: Add a metric to an existing tree, optionally as a child of another metric.

tools.name: analyze_metric
tools.title: Analyze Metric Performance
tools.summary: Fetch a metric's performance data for analysis.

tools.name: clone_tree_for_dimension
tools.title: Clone Tree for Dimension Value
tools.summary: Copy a tree's structure onto a different dimension value.

tools.name: compare_dimension_metrics
tools.title: Compare Dimension Metrics
tools.summary: Compare dimension breakdowns of a parent metric side-by-side.

tools.name: create_context_item
tools.title: Create Context Item
tools.summary: Add a human-typed context item (§3.2): extract → embed → attach.

tools.name: create_task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.summary: Create a new task (standalone or metric goal, individual or RACI-assigned).

tools.name: create_tree
tools.title: Create KPI Tree
tools.summary: Create a KPI tree.

tools.name: delete_task
tools.title: Delete Task
tools.summary: Delete a task (ownership enforced).

tools.name: delete_tree
tools.title: Delete Tree
tools.summary: Delete a KPI tree permanently: its canvas, nodes, edges and groups.

tools.name: derive_briefing
tools.title: Derive My Action Plan
tools.summary: Write the caller's own personal action plan from today's company briefing.

tools.name: dismiss_briefing_action
tools.title: Dismiss Briefing Action
tools.summary: Turn down one of the actions a briefing recommended.

tools.name: explore_data_model
tools.title: Explore Data Model
tools.summary: Explore the upstream data model (tables, columns, lineage) for a metric.

tools.name: explore_entity
tools.title: Explore Semantic Entity
tools.summary: Explore semantic layer entities, their dimensions, and linked metrics.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.title: Get Artifact
tools.summary: Admin escape hatch: read one stored artifact of any kind, whole.

tools.name: get_briefing
tools.title: Get Briefing
tools.summary: Today's briefing: what moved, who owns it, and what is already being done.

tools.name: get_briefing_finding
tools.title: Get Briefing Finding
tools.summary: One finding across its whole life, not just today's briefing.

tools.name: get_business_health
tools.title: Get Business Health
tools.summary: Get comprehensive business health across all metrics, organized by team.

tools.name: get_context_change
tools.title: Get Context Change
tools.summary: Fetch a single change by UUID, with its full diff and outcome evidence.

tools.name: get_context_item
tools.title: Get Context Item
tools.summary: Fetch a single context item by UUID.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.title: Get Current User Profile
tools.summary: Get the current user — who am I?

tools.name: get_initiative
tools.title: Get Initiative Details
tools.summary: Get detailed initiative information: budget, milestones, metric targets, impact evidence, linked objectives, tasks and check-ins.

tools.name: get_metric
tools.title: Get Metric Details
tools.summary: Fetch a single metric by ID with optimized relationship loading

tools.name: get_metric_calculations
tools.title: Get Metric Calculations
tools.summary: Calculate metric values with period comparisons and outlier detection.

tools.name: get_metric_drivers
tools.title: Get Metric Drivers
tools.summary: Find what's driving a metric's change using pre-computed statistical correlations.

tools.name: get_metric_raci
tools.title: Get Metric RACI
tools.summary: Who owns this metric now For a past moment use /metrics/{uuid}/raci/{as_at}, and for the full record use /metrics/{uuid}/raci/history.

tools.name: get_metric_raci_as_at
tools.title: Get Metric RACI As At
tools.summary: Who owned this metric at a point in time Assignments are intervals, so this returns exactly the people who held each role at that moment.

tools.name: get_metric_raci_history
tools.title: Get Metric RACI History
tools.summary: Every ownership assignment this metric has ever had Newest interval first.

tools.name: get_metric_relationships
tools.title: Get Metric Relationships
tools.summary: Get parent/child metric relationships and tree memberships for a metric.

tools.name: get_my_briefing
tools.title: Get My Briefing
tools.summary: Your action plan for today: what moved on your metrics, and what to do.

tools.name: get_my_preferences
tools.title: Get My Preferences
tools.summary: The caller's own saved interface preferences, as a key to value map.

tools.name: get_objective
tools.title: Get Objective Details
tools.summary: Get detailed objective information including key results, initiatives, check-ins and child objectives.

tools.name: get_overview_timeline
tools.title: Get Overview Timeline
tools.summary: Who is working on what this week, as lanes and dated items.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.title: Get Portfolio
tools.summary: Where the money is working: every initiative ranked by evidence.

tools.name: get_relevant_context
tools.title: Get Relevant Context
tools.summary: Retrieve from KPI Tree's Canopy business context layer the recorded notes, events, blockers and decisions that explain a metric or answer a question.

tools.name: get_task
tools.title: Get Task Details
tools.summary: Get a single task by UUID.

tools.name: get_tasks_for_metric
tools.title: Get Tasks for Metric
tools.summary: Get all tasks linked to a specific metric.

tools.name: get_tree
tools.title: Get KPI Tree
tools.summary: Fetch a single tree by ID with optimized loading of metrics

tools.name: get_user
tools.title: Get User Profile
tools.summary: Fetch a single active user by ID.

tools.name: get_user_group
tools.title: Get Directory Group Members
tools.summary: Get one identity provider directory group and the people in it.

tools.name: get_workflow
tools.title: Get Workflow Details
tools.summary: One workflow's trigger and steps — what it actually does when it fires.

tools.name: ingest_context_from_source
tools.title: Ingest Context From Source
tools.summary: Pull context from a connected source the user points you at.

tools.name: link_tree_node
tools.title: Link Tree Node
tools.summary: Place a linked tree node on a tree's canvas.

tools.name: list_briefings
tools.title: List Briefings
tools.summary: The index of briefings the caller can read, newest period first.

tools.name: list_context_changes
tools.title: List Context Changes
tools.summary: List the changes the model has learned (change history / observability), newest first, filtered by type, status, the metric they are about and the window they were recorded in.

tools.name: list_context_items
tools.title: List Context Items
tools.summary: List context items, filtered by kind, status, visibility, attached metric, source connection, or a prefix of the source locator.

tools.name: list_initiatives
tools.title: List Initiatives
tools.summary: List initiatives: the funded work behind objectives.

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.title: List All Metrics
tools.summary: Fetch all metrics metadata with optimized loading including trees data

tools.name: list_objectives
tools.title: List Objectives
tools.summary: List OKR objectives with their status and progress.

tools.name: list_scheduled_workflow_runs
tools.title: List Scheduled Workflow Runs
tools.summary: Upcoming scheduled workflow fires that include an AI-agent step, plus every platform workflow.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.title: List Tasks
tools.summary: List all tasks for the organisation.

tools.name: list_trees
tools.title: List KPI Trees
tools.summary: Fetch tree metadata without the node and edge graph.

tools.name: list_user_groups
tools.title: List Directory Groups
tools.summary: List the organisation's identity provider directory groups, with member counts.

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List Users
tools.summary: Fetch all active users.

tools.name: list_workflow_runs
tools.title: List Workflow Runs
tools.summary: Run history for one workflow, most recent first.

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.title: List Workflows
tools.summary: List the account's automations: what exists, who owns it, and whether it is live.

tools.name: propose_context_hypothesis
tools.title: Propose Context Hypothesis
tools.summary: Register a causal hunch — "this metric drives that one" — as a hypothesis for real outcomes to confirm, instead of asserting it.

tools.name: query_warehouse
tools.title: Query Warehouse
tools.summary: Run a read-only SELECT against the organisation's own data warehouse, through the KPI Tree connection that powers the named metric.

tools.name: recall
tools.title: Recall
tools.summary: Search everything KPI Tree remembers about a subject in one call: the recorded business context in Canopy AND the findings from company briefings, ranked together.

tools.name: remove_metric_from_tree
tools.title: Remove Metric from Tree
tools.summary: Remove a metric from a tree.

tools.name: rename_group
tools.title: Rename Group
tools.summary: Rename a group node on a tree's canvas.

tools.name: rename_tree
tools.title: Rename Tree
tools.summary: Rename a tree, and optionally reset its description.

tools.name: resolve_approval_task
tools.title: Resolve Approval Task
tools.summary: Resolve an approval task by setting its outcome to ``approved`` or ``rejected``.

tools.name: retract_context_item
tools.title: Retract Context Item
tools.summary: Soft-retract an item (``status = retracted``).

tools.name: revert_context_change
tools.title: Revert Context Change
tools.summary: Undo an applied change (the one human touchpoint, a safety valve, not an approval gate): re-apply the captured ``current_value`` through the same handler that applied it, then mark the row ``reverted`` with the caller as ``reverted_by``.

tools.name: search_metrics
tools.title: Search Metrics
tools.summary: Find metrics by name, or by what they are cut by, who owns them, or which tree they sit on.

tools.name: set_my_preference
tools.title: Set My Preference
tools.summary: Save one interface preference for the caller, replacing any earlier value.

tools.name: unlink_tree_node
tools.title: Unlink Tree Node
tools.summary: Remove a linked tree node from a tree's canvas.

tools.name: update_metric
tools.title: Update Metric
tools.summary: Update a metric

tools.name: update_task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.summary: Update a task (ownership enforced).

tools.name: update_tree_edges
tools.title: Update Tree Edges
tools.summary: Add or remove parent-child relationships in a tree.

tools.name: verify_driver_relationship
tools.title: Verify Driver Relationship
tools.summary: Check whether the statistical model supports the claim that one metric drives another before you assert it (the grounding verb).
